research_progress.source_confidence_semantics: Heuristic official-source research confidence only. Current Planning Data, GOV.UK/MHCLG and national planning-policy material checked on 25 July 2026. Article 4 directions, conservation-area data and Local Green Space guidance retain their published completeness, duplication, temporal and policy caveats. They are not parcel legal opinions, guarantees of planning refusal, proof of complete local coverage or Future Growth score accuracy.

source_facts.fact: The service reports 7,152 Article 4 direction areas from 111 providers, with collector/new-data date 24 July 2026.
source_facts.gate: Service coverage is not proof every local direction is represented or current.

source_facts.fact: The service reports 3,167 directions from 101 providers and describes the dataset as being developed with a small group of LPAs.
source_facts.gate: A direction record is not itself the rule text or proof it applies to every development type in the area.

source_facts.fact: The rule dataset currently reports 0 records from 1 provider, with new data last found in 2022.
source_facts.gate: Zero rule records are NO_DATA, not proof an Article 4 direction withdraws no rights.

source_facts.fact: Planning Data reports 11,007 conservation areas from 158 providers and explicitly says the service is incomplete and contains duplicates being reconciled.
source_facts.gate: No match is not proof a parcel is outside a conservation area; duplicates must not be double-counted.

source_facts.fact: MHCLG published a Local Green Space neighbourhood-plan toolkit on 24 July 2026 but states it has not yet been updated for recent planning-policy changes.
source_facts.gate: Toolkit content must not override current NPPF/PPG where policy has changed.

source_facts.fact: Planning Data documentation supports point-intersection screening across constraints such as conservation areas and Article 4 areas.
source_facts.gate: API intersection is screening evidence and not a legal title or permission decision.

core_rules: Article 4 direction is not automatic planning refusal
Article 4 direction removes only specified permitted development rights
Article 4 area intersection does not identify the withdrawn right without rule evidence
Article 4 direction record and area record must remain distinct
Article 4 rule NO_DATA must not become no withdrawn rights
Article 4 service coverage must not be assumed complete
Article 4 start and confirmation dates must be date-checked
expired or cancelled directions must not be treated as current
direction geometry is not a title boundary
direction-area geometry must not be treated as surveyed parcel geometry
absence from Planning Data is not proof no local Article 4 applies
local authority direction documents remain important where service data are incomplete
permitted-development status must be checked against current direction scope
Article 4 does not remove the ability to apply for planning permission
Article 4 is not a heritage designation by itself
conservation area and Article 4 direction must remain distinct
conservation-area intersection is not automatic refusal
conservation-area status is not listed-building status
conservation-area dataset is explicitly incomplete
conservation-area duplicates must not be double counted
service duplicate count must not become multiple legal designations without evidence
conservation-area boundary must not be inferred from point-only data
no service match must not become no conservation constraint
local designation documents can be more current than aggregated service data
Local Green Space is distinct from Green Belt
Local Green Space designation is not ownership
Local Green Space is not public-access proof
Local Green Space is not automatic development prohibition in every circumstance
Local Green Space proposal is not adopted designation
neighbourhood-plan evidence is not designation until plan process is complete
toolkit publication is not current-policy authority where caveated
24 July 2026 toolkit caveat must be preserved
current NPPF and PPG must take precedence over superseded toolkit assumptions
open-space value must not be inferred from aerial imagery alone
recreation use must not be inferred from polygon label alone
public open space and private green space must not be conflated
planning constraint API intersection is screening evidence
API result is not a legal opinion
coordinate intersection accuracy depends on source geometry
source-provider date must be retained for temporal accuracy
aggregated data origin warnings must not be removed
MHCLG-created fallback data must not be represented as authoritative local source where caveated
OGL licensing does not establish completeness
dataset count growth is not parcel planning probability
NO_DATA must remain NO_DATA rather than no constraint
research confidence is not parcel legal accuracy
no parcel Article4 conservation or Local Green Space outcome may be promoted while recovery is parked
business rows remain zero until canonical recovery completes
